Composition & Indication

Progesterone 100mg — 30 Capsules (Generic for Prometrium®) contains Micronized Progesterone 100 mg as the active ingredient. This presentation ships as a sealed pack of 30 Capsules at the official 100mg strength. The standard indication is the management of menopausal hormone therapy, per Mexican pharmacopeia labeling.

Typical Use

Progesterone 100mg is typically taken under medical supervision. Dose and duration should follow your physician’s prescription. Do not self-medicate. Possible side effects include common reactions described in the patient leaflet; consult your healthcare provider if any adverse symptom appears or persists.

CMC Pharmacy Cabo Service

Prescription Required. CMC Pharmacy Cabo verifies prescriptions per Mexican regulations (NOM-073-SSA1). Please consult your healthcare provider before use. Authentic product sourced from licensed Mexican distributors. Same-day delivery to Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and the Los Cabos tourist corridor. Bilingual customer support available 24/7 for visitors and residents.
